description: Repairs r-txn-1/clone-close-in-transaction: the row was not read between the clone's Update and its Close, so the call that ended the level was not isolated. On r-txn-1-a-accdb: dynaset rs on T; rc = rs.Clone; Workspaces(0).BeginTrans; rc.MoveFirst, Edit, V = 777, Update; read T through a new snapshot; rc.Close (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); read T through a new snapshot and the row of rs; Rollback (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); read T and the row of rs again; close; read T through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
